title: Classification of single-bubble blow-up solutions for Calogero--Moser derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation
summary: We study the Calogero--Moser derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation (CM-DNLS), a mass-critical and completely integrable dispersive model. Recent works established finite-time blow-up constructions and soliton resolution, describing the asymptotic behaviors of blow-up solutions. In this paper, we go beyond soliton resolution and provide a sharp classification of finite-time blow-up dynamics in the \textit{single-bubble} regime.
